finding: window_sharpness cannot carry a floor, and neither can laplacian_variance. The 13-label set suggested laplacian_variance@480x270 separated; at 34 labels the distributions overlap badly. WATCHABLE runs 0.63 to 180.83 and UNWATCHABLE (excluding the held-out clip) runs 2.60 to 25.61, so eight watchable windows sit below two unwatchable ones.
what_to_measure_instead: ANSWERED by run 34342326028, recorded in window_focus_metrics.json. laplacian_variance measured at 480x270 is the only candidate that both separates the labelled windows and rejects all three pexels:37239365 windows when the threshold is chosen without them. The same metric at 224x224 - what production decodes today - rejects none of them: the squash to the claim model's input lowpasses away the evidence blur leaves behind. Resolution is part of the answer, not an implementation detail.

candidate_threshold.aggregation: the weakest of the window's three sampled frames
candidate_threshold.how_chosen: geometric midpoint of the gap between the watchable minimum (39.48) and the highest non-held-out unwatchable window (4.81)
candidate_threshold.held_out_rejected: 3/3 - chosen without these and rejects them anyway
candidate_threshold.cost: 4 of the 45 windows that pass segment grounding, one of which is the known bad clip and one the BORDERLINE macro
candidate_threshold.not_shipped: Nothing gates on this. The low side of the gap rests on a single labelled window - a blank grey frame - and that is too thin an anchor to ship a production floor on.
candidate_threshold.superseded: 13.77 was chosen on 13 labels. On 34 it catches 4 of 6 blurred windows, loses 2 watchable ones, and the separation it appeared to have was an artefact of having only one non-held-out UNWATCHABLE example.

controlled_comparison: One clip settles the mechanism. pexels:8212402 is green apples falling through water on black - same camera, same lighting, same focus - and its three windows are all sharp and all WATCHABLE. They score 0.63, 18.20 and 29.35. The only thing that differs is how much of the frame the apple fills. laplacian_variance is a subject-size measure on a plain field, not a focus measure, which is the same fault edge_density had.

threshold_sweep_on_34_labels.note: blurred caught is of the 6 non-held-out UNWATCHABLE; watchable lost is of 23
threshold_sweep_on_34_labels.verdict: No row satisfies the success condition. The best detection rate that keeps watchable loss under 10% is 4 of 6, and it still rejects a pin-sharp green apple on black (0.63) - exactly the plain-background shot the gate was required to preserve. 100% detection costs 35% of the watchable windows.
